component.name: livemark
component.summary: Write markdown with a live preview

description.p: livemark is a desktop editor for markdown notes. You type markdown and it renders in place: headings sized, emphasis styled, and the markers hidden until the caret reaches them. The file stays plain markdown, so git and other editors work on the same text.

ul.li: Live preview of headings, emphasis, links, lists, task lists, quotes, tables, code and images
List-aware editing, formatting keys, find and replace
A toolbar, the markdown as written, and the rendered note side by side with it
Pasted pictures are saved next to the note
Light and dark mode, zoom, recent notes

description.p: It works offline: your notes stay as plain files on your computer.
